body:
Intelligence still mixes client-bill relevance inputs, two supported catalog matchers, manual tracking and tracked-bill enrichment in its facade. Move the complete 17-method capability into five concrete owners and one types/ports/projector module. The facade falls from 6,418 to 5,666 nonblank lines (6,839 to 6,044 physical). New production modules are at most 212 nonblank lines and complete functions at most 75 physical lines; constructor wiring remains 66 lines.

Preserve all 95 original method headers, 78 unrelated bodies, seven standalone exports, three constructor dependencies and actual Nest metadata. Independent reconstruction matches all 17 complete bodies / 104 top-level statements and all 18 SQL literal/binding entries. Relevant 150→25 and tracked 200→50 limits, fixed versus capability-sensitive floors, tenant-optional behavior, manual row multiplicity/merge counts, source overrides, keyword deadline/transaction, precomputed tracked promise authority, enrichment caps/counts and reference identity remain intact. Two canonical row projectors consolidate only proven identical projections.

Validation: unchanged production and the extraction pass the same 38 suites / 425 unique case identities, including 304 retained and 121 new cases, without skips. Two supplemental bill-ownership cases pass. Original failed new-test expectations are preserved; corrected scope traces/repeated binding and two explicit table-row title mappings are recorded. One erased test generic repair emits identical CommonJS/ESNext bytes. Full cold API typecheck, native Nest build, seven emitted-module syntax checks, actual three-dependency metadata and fifteen owned-file format checks pass; test assets stay excluded. Measured branches 522/1,239→516/1,233 exactly account for six covered duplicate projector arms; 717 uncovered arms remain. No business-coverage gain or historical coverage-floor acceptance is claimed. Independent review approves the exact committed source and recovery bundle.

Stacked on PR #2467 at exact base `348e542a44a6b842a5f0531280105f8e73dd3188`. Head `b78f9d4ce28089139d60b2c7a601750c99f67e69`, tree `264d044daa4c1e8c606f49793ffa612d7957e535`. Before/reviewed checkpoints, verified incremental recovery bundle, exact blob pins, raw native receipts and the finite remaining-capability inventory are retained.

This closes client-bill discovery/tracking/enrichment ownership. Eleven Intelligence families and broader Cleanup remain open; active legacy consumers, frontend replacement/CI prerequisites and protected rebuild ownership remain required scope. All 17 baseline member bodies equal the admitted Core source `1e99f0921b207318c6d2abf03927b5c4daa5768b`; actual live-image build-tree equivalence remains unestablished. No main merge/deployment, database/provider/AWS/credential/security action, accepted Completion/profile owner rewrite, migration/CI/package/protected rebuild change or history deletion. This stacked draft does not establish main-only CI execution.
